correctness.rationale: For each world w, membership w in S(X) is upward closed in X and the three pairwise incomparable blocks E_i[w] are exactly its three minimal generators; this recovers the unordered local triple from ALL Boolean subsets. Another 3-agent realization cannot have additional redundant generators as its three local classes must equal the three minima; intersections of distinct same-agent blocks forbidden imply a proper 3-colouring of the globally recovered block graph. At every w three blocks form a triangle, so any proper 3-colouring uses all colours exactly once and yields one equivalence partition per colour, establishing a bijection without assuming alternative local irredundance. Independent partition enumeration n=4,5,6 generated the Bell numbers 15,52,203 and recovered 1,30,825 signatures respectively; six-world histogram 815 fibres of 6 and ten fibres of 12. Each exceptional signature consists of nine K3,3 edges; order-three Latin square has 12 edge-colourings and a connected union of accessibilities. Finite exhaustive census is exact only through n6; the chromatic theorem is proved for all finite W by the generator/colour equivalence.
